items.title: The degree-n Fermat polynomial has determinantal complexity at least one point five n minus three
items.author: Mrinal Kumar; Ben Lee Volk
items.source_version: Official complete CCC2021 publication,2021-07-08,pp.4:1–4:12; published Sections1–3 and mainTheorem1 proof
items.difficulty_reason: The authors use singular-variety geometry to normalize a determinantal representation, trade matrix dimension for polynomial entry degree through a Schur complement, and apply a product-decomposition dimension bound to obtain the improved constant-factor lower bound.

primary.label: Official author mainTheorem1 with n at least6 over complex numbers

proof_spans.label: Complete official Section3: normalization, singular locus, Schur complement, higher-degree lemma and final proof
